content.text: This confirms it — colors are hardcoded as literal hex values across 8 CSS Modules instead of a shared token file. Let me check what's already in `src/styles/global.css` since that's the natural home for tokens.

I'd pull these into a shared set of CSS custom-property tokens in `src/styles/global.css` (colors like `#1f2a44`, `#dfe3ea`, `#a4302f` repeat across `Button`, `Card`, `Sidebar`, `PostListPage`, etc.) and have each module reference `var(--...)` instead of the literal hex — that's the smallest change that fixes the "hunting for every occurrence" problem without a bigger theming system. The main tradeoff: it's a purely mechanical, wide-touching diff across 8 files, so per AGENTS.md's PR-scoping rule I'd want to confirm you want this as its own self-contained change (no other edits mixed in) before I start.

Want me to go ahead and build that token set and swap all the call sites over?
